note: Illinois DNR park at Marseilles on the Illinois River. Two campgrounds: Great Falls, whose front row of electric sites faces the river across open lawn, and Whitetail, about a kilometre west in the woods. Electric boxes are shared, so an extension cord can help. --Claude
summary: IDNR camping/park pages, 2027 fees, all 103 ExploreMoreIL units, imagery (leaf-on and leaf-off) and 3DEP read. Base corrected $11 -> $28: every B/S site is capped at 20 ft, so a 23-ft rig needs a Class A electric site. 50 A on Great Falls 009-012 (stored 30 -> 50). 103 sites; fcfs some_sites (9 walk-up units); reservation season 05-01..10-31. Riverview kept: the engine's 'Waterfront Site' row (003-018) sits 25-45 m back over lawn, a tree fringe and a ~4 m bank. Split candidate Great Falls / Whitetail.
flags: BASE RATE (23-ft fit): stored $11 (+$17 electric) is the Class B-S rate, but all 55 B-S units (Great Falls 028-058, Whitetail 081-104) carry Max Vehicle Length 20 / Pad Length 20 - a 23-ft rig does not fit them. Base corrected to Class A Electric $28 (2027; engine 2026 price $20); surcharge cleared.

WATERFRONT (riverview kept; engine claim lead): the engine tags Great Falls 003-018 'Waterfront Site'. Those back-in pads (e.g. 013 at 41.32055,-88.70601, 015 at 41.32059,-88.70551) face the Illinois River main channel (~270 m wide, Marseilles pool, no levee - the pads are on the natural bank) over open mown grass with scattered trees, but the water's edge is 25-45 m from the pads beyond a tree fringe along the bank, and the ground drops ~4 m (3DEP: 151.1 m at 18 m from pad 015, pool 147.0 m) to it - a climb-down bank. Best case is 'riverfront with a caveat' for 004-018 if the bank is judged walkable; on the rule (bench above a graded slope, tree fringe) it stays riverview. Whitetail is set back in woods, no water value.

AMPS: 50 A on Great Falls 009-012 (all four waterfront-tagged, web-bookable); 30 A on the other 44 Class A units. No unit lists a water or sewer hookup; stored water false left (absence of an amenity is not a statement).
FIT: Class A Max Vehicle Length 40 on 41 units, 30 on 064 and 066-068, 25 on 060, 061 and 077 - a 23-ft rig fits every Class A site. All B-S sites 20 ft max (see base rate).
